_comment: A SMOKE fixture, not the scoring set. It exists to prove the harness runs end to end and
to pin stage 0's behaviour on the shapes its rules were written for. It cannot produce
#5338's number — `assertCanGate` refuses on role=smoke — and it must never be promoted to
role=evaluation by editing this field: an evaluation set has to say where its labels came
from, and these were authored by hand alongside the harness, which is exactly the conflict
practices.md's structural rule exists to prevent.
Every body here is invented. None is customer content, and none is derived from any

episodes.body: Priya took over as the on-call lead for Payments starting this sprint.
The billing service runs in us-east-1, not us-west-2 — we moved it in March.
Our SOC 2 Type II report is renewed every October by Vanta.
Checkout latency budget is 300ms p95; anything above that pages the on-call.
The data warehouse is Snowflake. We dropped BigQuery last year.
Marco owns the pricing page copy now that Dana has moved to growth.
I think the API might be slow sometimes? Not sure.
Someone said we were going to switch to Postgres 18 at some point maybe.
Reminder: standup moved to 10:15 tomorrow only.
Anyone got a minute to pair on this?
